description: Sarvam Kaze will be launched in India later this year, in May, by Sarvam AI, the Indian AI firm, the co-founder of the company, Pratyush Kumar, announced on Tuesday. The new wearables will be unveiled in the country as the company's AI-powered device. Sarvam AI is known for providing AI text-to-speech and speech-to-text tools, including Bulbul v3. The upcoming Sarvam Kaze AI smart glasses were showcased on February 16 at India's AI Impact Summit 2026, which is taking place at New Delhi's Bharat Mandapam.
title: AI Impact Summit: Sarvam Kaze Smart Glasses Showcased, Will Launch in India in May

description: Assassin's Creed Shadows is getting a new update this week that will add the long-requested manual jump feature for advanced parkour moves. Title Update 1.1.18 rolls out on all platforms on February 17. Ubisoft also announced a parkour challenge for AC Shadows players.
title: Assassin's Creed Shadows Gets Manual Jump Feature With Title Update 1.1.8

description: Directed by David Freyne, Eternity is a 2025 American fantasy-romance-comedy film that has finally made its way to digital screens. The film revolves around the story of an elderly woman who passes away and meets her husband in the afterlife. The film has finally made its debut in India, and viewers can now stream it exclusively on Apple TV+, although a subscription is required.
title: Eternity Now Available for Streaming on Apple TV+: Where to Watch Elizabeth Olsen and Miles Teller’s Afterlife Rom-Com?

description: Sony Group has developed a technology that identifies copyrighted music embedded in AI-generated songs and estimates creator contributions, according to a Nikkei Asia report. The system can analyse training data or compare AI output with music catalogues and may support compensation frameworks and licensing negotiations for AI-generated content.
title: Sony Reportedly Develops New Tech That Can Trace Original Music in AI Songs

description: Vivo V70 FE launch could be around the corner, as an alleged promotional image and RAM and storage variants of the smartphone have surfaced online. The new leak aligns with all the rumours and speculations that have cropped up around the Vivo V70 FE recently. The render shows the phone in two colour options with a dual rear camera unit. I
title: Vivo V70 FE Design Seen in Leaked Promo Image; Tipster Leaks RAM and Storage Configurations

description: Vivo X300 FE has surfaced in a new leak revealing its expected storage variants and colour options. A tipster claims the phone could launch in 12GB + 256GB and 12GB + 512GB configurations, with black and blue shades. The handset has also appeared on Geekbench with Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 12GB RAM, and Android 16. Other listings suggest 90W fast charging and confirmed connectivity features. Vivo X300 FE is expected to be a rebranded Vivo S50 Pro Mini.
title: Vivo X300 FE Tipped to Launch in Two RAM and Storage Configurations: Expected Features, Colourways and More

description: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Leica Edition has reportedly been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform. The listing reveals that the smartphone will be launched in select global markets with the octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm, built on a 3nm process, which also powers the phone’s Chinese counterpart. The handset also appeared with Android 16 and 16GB of RAM. It is expected to ship with Xiaomi’s HyperOS 3. It could be launched ahead of the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026, along with the Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Xiaomi 17.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Leica Edition Visits Geekbench Ahead of Global Launch: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Here are five of the best gaming laptops currently available in India. All these models are priced under Rs. 1 lakh and offer high-refresh-rate panels, new Intel processors, and long-lasting batteries. The list includes the Asus Gaming V16, HP Victus 15, Dell 15, Lenovo LOQ and Acer Nitro Lite 16. They feature high-end components designed for gaming performance.
title: Best Gaming Laptops Under Rs. 1 Lakh in India: Asus Gaming V16, HP Victus 15 and More

description: Laser and inkjet printers differ in speed, print quality, maintenance, and long-term costs. Laser printers offer fast printing, sharp text, and lower cost per page, making them ideal for offices and high-volume use, though they cost more upfront. Inkjet printers are cheaper initially and better for colour and photo printing, but ink can be expensive and may dry out. Long-term costs depend on consumables, page yield, and upkeep. Understanding myths, pros, cons, and best use cases helps buyers choose wisely.
title: Laser Printer vs Inkjet Printer: Key Differences, Pros, Cons and Long-Term Costs Explained

description: New research suggests the Universe’s expansion could eventually reverse, leading to a dramatic “Big Crunch.” By analyzing dark energy survey data, scientists propose expansion may stop in about 11 billion years before contraction begins. The model predicts a final cosmic collapse roughly 20 billion years from now, though uncertainties remain and future observations will test it.
title: New Study Predicts Cosmic ‘Big Crunch’ Could End Everything in 20 Billion Years

description: Hackers are sending fake letters to customers of Trezor and Ledger, the cryptocurrency wallet security firms, impersonating the two companies. The letters purportedly include the signatures of senior company executives, along with a QR code. This QR code allegedly takes users to a "scam website", where customers are duped into sharing their account recovery phrases, which the bad actors are using to gain access to the cryptocurrency wallets.
title: Hackers Send Physical Phishing Letters Impersonating Trezor and Ledger to Trick Users

description: The Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G is now available for purchase in India. The handset was launched in the country on February 9 as the first model in the South Korean tech conglomerate’s Galaxy F70 lineup, and is positioned as an affordable model. It sports a 6.7-inch HD+ 120Hz LCD screen. The Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and packs a 6,000mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70e 5G With 120Hz LCD Screen, Dimensity 6300 SoC Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Infinix is looking to release its Infinix Note 60 series soon. Now, the Infinix Note 60 Ultra appeared on the FCC database, revealing its battery details. The handset could launch with a 6,000mAh battery in select markets and a larger 7,000mAh cell in others. Additionally, alleged renders of the phone have leaked online. The renders show the phone in a black shade with a secondary display on the rear.
title: Infinix Note 60 Ultra Battery Details Revealed by US FCC Listing; Leaked Renders Hint at Secondary Display

description: On the second day of the country’s inaugural AI Impact Summit, the Union Minister of Electronics and Information Technology (IT), Ashwini Vaishnaw, spoke about artificial intelligence (AI), India’s global standing in this technology, and several other related topics. The Minister also addressed the concerns about deepfakes and highlighted the need for stricter regulation.
title: India AI Summit: Ashwini Vaishnaw Calls AI 5th Industrial Revolution, Shares Plans for UPI-Like AI Platform

description: Written by Shaji Maarad, Paathirathri is a Malayalam crime thriller film that will soon debut on digital screens. The film revolves around two police officers who become entangled in a deadly investigation after discovering a body during a routine night patrol. The film will make its digital debut on February 20, 2026, exclusively on ZEE5. Viewers will require an active subscription to stream it online.
title: Paathirathri OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Navya Nair and Soubin Shahir Starrer Online?

description: Android XR OS was announced by Google last year. The platform, designed for extended reality (XR) devices, has now surfaced in early screenshots, offering a first look at its user interface and overall design philosophy. According to a report, the leaked images hint towards the operating system featuring a clean and minimal layout designed specifically for spatial computing.
title: Android XR OS Reportedly Leaks in Early Screenshots; to Offer Clean Spatial Interface, ‘Glimmer’ Design

description: Apple has introduced Playlist Playground, a new Apple Intelligence feature in the iOS 26.4 developer beta for Apple Music. The tool lets users generate playlists using text prompts based on moods, genres, or themes. Users can access it from the Library section while creating a new playlist, and Apple Music will suggest songs automatically. Playlists can be refined with follow-up prompts and customised before saving. iOS 26.4 beta also includes dynamic backgrounds and a possible concerts discovery feature.
title: iOS 26.4 Beta 1: Apple Music Gets New AI-Powered Playlist Playground Feature

description: Anthropic and Infosys announced a partnership at the sidelines of India’s inaugural AI Impact Summit. Both companies stated that the collaboration will focus on jointly developing artificial intelligence (AI)-powered enterprise solutions. The two entities will also focus on developing agentic tools and AI agents to transform enterprises’ legacy systems into modern AI-first frameworks.
title: India AI Summit: Anthropic, Infosys Announce Partnership to Bring Agentic AI Solutions for Enterprises

description: Valve has confirmed that ongoing memory and storage shortages has impacted Steam Deck OLED stocks in the US. All three Steam Deck models are currently out of stock on the official Steam store in the country. Valve said OLED models "may be out-of-stock intermittently in some regions due to memory and storage shortages".
title: Valve Says Steam Deck OLED Is Out of Stock Due to RAM and Storage Shortages

description: The Infinix GT 50 Pro could launch soon. Ahead of the official launch, the renders and key specifications of the handset have surfaced online. The handset is tipped to feature a MediaTek Dimensity chipset. It is expected to feature a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and a 6,500mAh battery. The renders show the phone in a black shade.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Design Leaked, Specifications Might Include Dimensity 8400 Ultimate Chip

description: Jr NTR teams up with Prashanth Neel for Dragon, a grand action entertainer with a massive OTT deal on Netflix. The film promises intense action, emotional depth, and a powerful cinematic experience after its theatrical run. Dragon is scheduled to hit theaters in Summer 2027. According to reports, the film's digital rights have been acquired by Netflix in a deal reportedly worth nearly Rs. 125 crore, and it will be available on the platform following its theatrical run.
title: Dragon OTT Platform Reportedly Locked: What You Need to Know About Jr NTR’s Mega Action Film

description: AI Impact Summit 2026 is in full swing, hosting industry leaders and technocrats from across the world. On the sidelines of the summit, on Tuesday, the Union Minister of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Ashwini Vaishnaw, revealed that India expects to receive more than $200 billion (about Rs. 18.15 Lakh Crore) worth of investments in the country’s AI and deep tech ecosystem over the next two years. The AI adoption in the country is expected to leverage the existing technology framework, created with the help of India’s digital public infrastructure.
title: AI Impact Summit: India Expected to Witness Over $200 Billion Worth of AI Investments, IT Minister Says

description: Adani Group has announced a $100 billion (roughly Rs. 9,07,300 crore) investment to develop renewable-powered hyperscale data centres for AI workloads by 2035, during the India AI Impact Summit 2026. The company said the programme could generate another $150 billion (roughly Rs. 13,61,100 crore) in related investments across servers, manufacturing, and cloud infrastructure. Adani Group plans to scale AdaniConneX’s capacity from 2GW to 5GW, with partnerships involving Google, Microsoft, and Flipkart. It also said it will support Indian startups, strengthen domestic supply chains, and build AI infrastructure talent.
title: Adani Group Announces $100 Billion Plan for Hyperscale AI-Ready Data Centres by 2035

description: Realme’s P4 Power is not your usual mid-range smartphone, while it seems to check all the boxes for such a device, Realme has done the unbelievable by shoving in a powerbank-sized 10,001mAh battery in it. With most mid-range and even budget devices these days easily delivering over 1.5 days of casual usage, is there a need for such a high-capacity battery in 2026? Also, can the Realme P4 Power work like the brand’s Dart-branded power banks?
title: Realme P4 Power Review: Do You Need a Smartphone With a 10,000mAh Battery?

description: Samsung’s first Galaxy Unpacked event of 2026 is scheduled to take place on February 25. Alongside the purported Galaxy S26 series, the South Korean tech conglomerate is also expected to take the wraps off its next-generation true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy Buds 4 series. Ahead of launch, the purported TWS earphones have now reportedly surfaced in leaked renders, offering an early look at their design.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4, Galaxy Buds 4 Pro Renders Leaked Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked Event

description: Apple has started rolling out the first beta version of the iOS 26.4 update for developers. The new firmware version brings various new features and design changes. The company has announced that the beta version introduces the new video podcasts functionality for the Apple Podcasts app, which allows users to stream video podcasts using the HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) protocol. Additionally, developers can now test the Rich Communication Services (RCS) end-to-end encryption messaging protocol.
title: iOS 26.4 Beta 1 Rolled Out With iPhone Security Improvements, Video Podcasts as Apple Tests RCS Encryption

description: On the second day of the inaugural AI Impact Summit, which is being hosted in New Delhi, a very interesting announcement has emerged. A Bengaluru-based artificial intelligence (AI) startup, Bharat1, has laid out the plans to build the world’s first “humanity-first” AI city in Bengaluru. While on the surface, the idea seems fantastical, the researchers are not really trying to have AI models run the entire city.
title: India AI Summit: This Startup Wants to Build the World’s First AI City in Bengaluru

description: India's smartphone market ended 2025 on a flat note shows a new report by IDC. The market witnessed a slow start, and shipments came on track in the second and third quarters. The total smartphone shipments touched 152 billion units, and Vivo led shipments. Samsung and Oppo came in second and third positions, respectively. Apple led the premium and mid-premium smartphone categories in the last year.
title: iPhone Shipments Soared, Vivo Extended Lead as India's Smartphone Market Stayed Flat in 2025: IDC

description: Developer Pearl Abyss has confirmed that its upcoming open world action-adventure game, Crimson Desert, will not feature any microtransactions. The game will also not include a cosmetics cash shop. Crimson Desert is a "premium experience" that users only need to pay for once, the studio said.
title: Crimson Desert a 'Premium' Experience, Will Not Have Microtransactions, Pearl Abyss Confirms

description: Huawei Band 11 Pro has surfaced online through a new leak, revealing expected launch details, price, colour options, and specifications. The tracker could debut in Germany in black, blue, and green shades. It is tipped to feature an aluminium or titanium-aluminium body with IP67 and 50-metre water resistance. The Band 11 Pro may include a 1.62-inch AMOLED display, built-in GPS, multiple health sensors, call support, and up to 14 days of battery life.
title: Huawei Band 11 Pro Launch Timeline, Price, Colour Options and Key Features Leaked

description: Lava Bold N2 has been launched in India as the latest addition to the Noida-based tech firm’s Bold N lineup. The new smartphone from Lava will go on sale in the country on February 27. It will be available for purchase in India exclusively via Amazon. The phone is offered in two colour options, dubbed Indus Black and Siachen White. The Unisoc SC9863A chipset, paired with 4GB of RAM, powers the Lava Bold N2. The smartphone also features a 5,000mAh battery and a 13-megapixel rear camera.
title: Lava Bold N2 Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Created by Soumik Sen, Jazz City is an upcoming Bengali historical thriller series set to debut soon on digital screens. Centered in Calcutta during 1971, the show explores the era of the Bangladesh Liberation War. This series will begin streaming on March 19, 2026, exclusively on Sony LIV. Viewers will require an active subscription to stream it online.
title: Jazz City Streams on OTT From March 19: What You Need to Know About Soumik Sen’s Historical Thriller

description: Nothing announced a launch event on Tuesday, which will take place in early March. The announcement comes after Apple set forth a ‘special experience’ for March 4, where it could debut the iPhone 17e and a range of MacBook models. While the UK-based brand has yet to reveal specifics, the rumour mill suggests that it may launch two new smartphones, part of the purported Nothing Phone 4 series, along with a pair of headphones.
title: Nothing CEO Carl Pei Announces March 5 Event; Nothing Phone 4a, Phone 4a Pro Expected

description: Google is reportedly expanding the split-screen compatibility of the Gemini app to non-foldable smartphones. As per the report, Gemini can now operate side-by-side in the split-screen mode even on regular handsets. So far, this capability has been limited to larger displays, such as foldables and tablets. But it appears that the Mountain View-based tech giant is slowly expanding it to all devices.
title: Google Reportedly Expands Gemini Split-Screen Feature to Non-Foldable Smartphones

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra will be launched by the South Korean smartphone maker with a 12-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls, featuring a Sony 1/3.2-inch sensor with an f/2.2 aperture and an 85-degree wide field-of-view, according to a tipster. The handset is expected to be unveiled during the upcoming Galaxy Unpacked 2026 event, which is scheduled to take place on February 25 at 10 am PT/1 pm ET (11:30 pm IST) in San Francisco, California. The handset could debut along with the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, Galaxy Buds 4, and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Tipped to Launch With Upgraded 12-Megapixel Selfie Camera

description: Samsung has posted a new Galaxy S26 series teaser video that demonstrates how the new Privacy Display feature is expected to function. The feature is likely to debut with the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, which is expected to work similarly to a privacy filter found on laptops or phones. The feature will make the display dark when viewed from side angles. This is expected to be useful for handling sensitive information. The Privacy Display feature could be exclusive to the S26 Ultra
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra's 'Zero-Peeking’ Privacy Feature Teased Days Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked Event

description: Vivo has refreshed the V60 Lite 4G with Qualcomm’s new Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 4G chipset, replacing the Snapdragon 685 used in last year’s model. Listed in Panama as V2549, the phone retains other specifications, including 8GB RAM, 256GB storage, and Android 15-based Funtouch OS 15. It features a 6.77-inch AMOLED display, 50-megapixel dual rear cameras, a 32-megapixel selfie shooter, a 6,500mAh battery with 90W charging, and an IP65 rating.
title: Vivo V60 Lite 4G (2026) Launched With Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 Chip and 6,500mAh Battery

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is scheduled to go official later this month. As we wait for its official debut, the purported Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra have surfaced in early benchmark listings, revealing notable performance differences between chipset variants. The Snapdragon-powered Galaxy S26 Ultra reportedly delivers significantly stronger single-core scores compared to the Exynos-powered Galaxy S26, highlighting the performance gap between Qualcomm and Samsung’s in-house silicon in certain markets.
title: Snapdragon-Powered Galaxy S26 Ultra Leads Exynos-Powered S26 in Early Benchmarks: Report

description: Apple is said to have scheduled a “special Apple experience” event for early March, fuelling speculation about the debut of the new non-Pro iPhone model. Reports suggest that the Cupertino-based tech giant could host an event in at least three separate locations, although the company has not publicly announced the event. Among the expected announcements is the iPhone 17e, M5-powered MacBook Air, MacBook Pro powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, and potentially Apple’s first-ever low-cost MacBook.
title: Apple Reportedly Announces ‘Special Experience’ on March 4; May Launch iPhone 17e, Low-Cost MacBook
